class.name: JustAMCPRuntime
class.brief_description: Engine singleton that hosts the JustAMCP runtime server.
class.description:
[JustAMCPRuntime] hosts the exported or play-mode MCP endpoint. The HTTP host exposes only project-owned tools and prompts registered with [method register_tool] and [method register_prompt]. The TCP bridge still accepts [method register_custom_command]. It is independent of the active [SceneTree], so it can keep serving while scenes are opened, closed, or changed. The game HTTP MCP host listens on [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/export_port] when set, otherwise the editor port plus one (6506 → 6507). Autowork [code]--aw-*[/code] does not start MCP unless [code]--enable-mcp[/code] or [code]--enable-mcp-game-control[/code] is also passed. Project-owned Cursor tools register through [method register_tool]; TCP [method register_custom_command] stays for the game-control bridge. [codeblock] JustAMCPRuntime.port = 6507 JustAMCPRuntime.enabled = true
JustAMCPRuntime.register_tool("echo", "Echo text", {"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}}}, func(args): return args.get("text", "") )
JustAMCPRuntime.register_custom_command("double", func(value): return value * 2 ) [/codeblock]

method.name: execute_command
method.description: Executes a runtime command with [param params] and returns the command result dictionary. Commands include built-in runtime operations, tool dispatch, resources, prompts, and [code]run_custom_command[/code].

method.name: is_listening
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the HTTP MCP host or TCP game-control bridge is accepting connections.

method.name: list_tools
method.description: Returns schemas for project-owned tools registered with [method register_tool].

method.name: load_project_mcp_scripts
method.description: Loads [code]register.gd[/code] and [code]register.luau[/code] from [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/project_mcp_dir] (default [code]res://mcp[/code]) so those scripts can call [method register_tool] and [method register_prompt].

method.name: poll
method.description: Processes pending network activity for the runtime server, including new connections, inbound MCP payloads, and queued asynchronous work.

method.name: register_custom_command
method.description: Registers [param callable] under [param name] so MCP clients can invoke it with [code]execute_command("run_custom_command", {"name": name, "args": [...]})[/code]. Registering the same name replaces the previous callable.

method.name: register_prompt
method.description: Registers a project-owned MCP prompt. [param callable] receives the prompt argument dictionary and should return messages or a string. Same ClassDB API for GDScript and Luau.

method.name: register_tool
method.description: Registers a project-owned Streamable HTTP MCP tool that appears in [code]tools/list[/code] and is invoked by [code]tools/call[/code]. [param input_schema] is a JSON Schema object. Same ClassDB API for GDScript and Luau.

method.name: unregister_custom_command
method.description: Removes the custom command registered as [param name]. Calls to [code]run_custom_command[/code] with that name will return an error after removal.

method.name: unregister_prompt
method.description: Removes the project-owned MCP prompt registered as [param name].

method.name: unregister_tool
method.description: Removes the project-owned MCP tool registered as [param name].

members.member: When [code]true[/code], the runtime server is active and can accept MCP traffic. Setting it to [code]false[/code] stops serving runtime requests.

Game MCP port. Defaults to the editor HTTP port plus one (6506 → 6507). Override with [code]--mcp-game-port[/code] or [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/export_port]. Never bind the editor port. [code]remote_control[/code] also defaults to 6507; if bind fails the host retries once on port+1.

signal.name: client_connected
signal.description: Emitted when a new MCP client connects to the runtime server.

signal.name: client_disconnected
signal.description: Emitted when an MCP client disconnects or the runtime closes its connection.

signal.name: command_received
signal.description: Emitted after the runtime parses an incoming MCP command. The signal exposes the command name and decoded parameter dictionary before dispatch.
